class Node:
    """Doubly linked list node to store the key-value pair and links to previous and next nodes."""
    
    def __init__(self, key: int, value: int):
        self.key = key
        self.value = value
        self.prev = None
        self.next = None

class LRUCache:
    """LRU Cache implementation using a hashmap and a doubly linked list for O(1) get and put operations."""
    
    def __init__(self, capacity: int):
        self.capacity = capacity
        self.cache = {}
        self.head = Node(0, 0)  # Dummy head
        self.tail = Node(0, 0)  # Dummy tail
        self.head.next = self.tail
        self.tail.prev = self.head
        
    def _remove(self, node: Node):
        """Remove a node from the linked list."""
        prev_node = node.prev
        next_node = node.next
        prev_node.next = next_node
        next_node.prev = prev_node

    def _add_to_front(self, node: Node):
        """Add a node right after the head (front of the linked list)."""
        node.next = self.head.next
        node.prev = self.head
        self.head.next.prev = node
        self.head.next = node

    def get(self, key: int) -> int:
        """Retrieve the value associated with the key and mark it as most recently used."""
        if key in self.cache:
            node = self.cache[key]
            self._remove(node)
            self._add_to_front(node)
            return node.value
        return -1

    def put(self, key: int, value: int) -> None:
        """Insert or update the value of the key and manage the LRU order."""
        if key in self.cache:
            # Update existing node
            node = self.cache[key]
            self._remove(node)
            node.value = value
            self._add_to_front(node)
        else:
            if len(self.cache) >= self.capacity:
                # Remove the least recently used item
                lru_node = self.tail.prev
                self._remove(lru_node)
                del self.cache[lru_node.key]
            # Create a new node
            new_node = Node(key, value)
            self.cache[key] = new_node
            self._add_to_front(new_node)
